note.value: Crew: Draw 4 specialist Norse crew counters between Ulfwerener, Berserker, Huscarls & Bondsmen to replace 4 of the crew on the Kingship. The distribution of counters from SoB was 6 of each. (Note: roll 4d4 with 1: Ulfwerener, 2: Berserker, 3: Huscarls, 4: Bondsmen will give close to the same distribution). As such, a Kingship has 1 Thrall which acts as a normal crew.
